body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-26 about 03:36Z), from measured evidence (w-20f0f0dc67be, Sol-c593's OS capture during gate C, 03:21-03:33Z): rustc accounted for about 85% of retained process write I/O (19 GB in about 12 min, about 27 MB/s), C: was about 93% busy with mean queue about 11.5, and termal.exe wrote only about 74 kB/s. Concurrent COLD compiles in fresh worktrees (each about 5-10 GB of target/ writes) plus a full gate saturate C:, which slows everything else, including the TermAl writer and API calls.
RULE for TermAl coding lanes:
- Prefer reusing your OWN existing worktree for the next item: reset it to the new base and keep its target/ warm. Create a new root only when the old one must stay frozen (a READY handed to Merger2, a gate input, or evidence).
- Avoid starting a cold compile while a full gate is in its compile stage when a warm root is available.
- Never share or touch another lane's worktree.
- No product or config change is implied; this is scheduling only.
